title: pdf_create offer and the writes-PDFs switch (manual until automated)

clauses.text: By default the assistant can offer pdf_create, and it asks first.

steps.do: Ask the assistant to make a PDF of a short note.
steps.expect: It asks first with an approval card before it creates the PDF.

clauses.text: The switch is a key on Settings, Models (P) and Settings, Agents (p), and a model or agent that writes PDFs shows the writes PDFs chip.

steps.do: As an administrator, open Settings, Models, press P on a model. Then open Settings, Agents and press p on an agent.
steps.expect: The model or agent shows the writes PDFs chip. Turn the switch back off and check the chip is gone.

clauses.text: pdf_output_status answers at once; pdf_output_set asks every time and is for administrators.

steps.do: Ask the assistant what the PDF output setting is, then ask it to turn the writes-PDFs setting on.
steps.expect: The status comes back at once. The change shows an approval card each time, and a person who is not an administrator is refused.

clauses.text: With the switch on, the assistant no longer offers pdf_create for that model or agent, and the other PDF tools stay.

steps.do: With the switch on for the chat model, ask the assistant for a PDF.
steps.expect: No pdf_create approval card appears. The other PDF tools still work.
